title: Synvora Skin: AI Face Scan App - App Store
excerpt: Download Synvora Skin: AI Face Scan by David Oladipupo on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips and more apps like Synvora Skin: AI…
content_html:
Skincare routine and acne care

Only for iPhone

Free · In-App Purchases · Designed for iPhone. Not verified for macOS.

iPhone

Synvora reads your skin from a guided face scan, explains what it sees in plain language, and builds a routine around it — using products that fit your budget. A SCAN THAT'S HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT CAN SEE Synvora guides you through a short three-angle scan and grades eight things it can observe: dehydration, oiliness, texture, pores, redness, breakouts, uneven tone and fine lines. Each finding is marked on your own photo so you can see exactly which area it refers to. It is deliberately cautious. If the lighting is too poor for a clean read, it asks for a retake instead of guessing. If it isn't sure about something, it says so and marks the finding as uncertain rather than asserting it. PLAIN LANGUAGE, NOT JARGON Every result is written the way a knowledgeable friend would say it. No clinical vocabulary, no scores you have to decode. PRODUCTS THAT FIT YOUR BUDGET Set what you're willing to spend and Synvora matches real products to your skin within it — including inexpensive ones. You'll also see cheaper alternatives to products you already use, so you can decide what's worth the money. A ROUTINE THAT ADAPTS Your morning and evening routine adjusts to your skin, the season and your local climate. Reminders are optional and off by default apart from the basics. TRACK WHAT ACTUALLY CHANGES Scan again whenever you like. Synvora keeps your history and shows how each measure has moved over time, so you can tell whether something is working instead of guessing. ASK QUESTIONS A built-in coach answers questions about your own results and routine, with your scan history as context. WHAT SYNVORA IS NOT Synvora describes visible skin traits and suggests cosmetic skincare products. It does not diagnose, treat, or provide medical advice. For any skin concern, please see a qualified professional. YOUR PHOTOS Scan photos are used to produce your report and are stored to your account so you can revisit past scans. You can delete your account and all associated data, including stored photos, from Settings at any time. SUBSCRIPTION Synvora Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription. Price and billing period are shown before purchase and payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.
